purpose: Teach: 炸裂/廃墟/米兵/不毛/飢餓/自決/滅亡/査察

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時下に爆弾が炸裂した事件の記録を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the historical records of bomb incidents during wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, observational opening. Warm but professional — a teacher drawing out a student's own thinking. Light pause before the question mark, inviting her to build on it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦災の廃墟の中の生活史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the lived experience within the ruins of wartime destruction.
lines.style: Direct, confident but not performed. She's grounded in her subject. Slight emphasis on the word "lived" — claiming intellectual ownership. Clear cadence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下に米兵が駐留した影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the impact of American soldiers being stationed there during the war — that was part of your research, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing. A teacher checking whether the student had considered the full scope. Warm curiosity, not interrogation. Slight tilt toward her at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、不毛な政治論争を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, but I examined the barren political discourse that arose from it, rather than the occupation itself.
lines.style: Measured correction, not defensive. She's clarifying her own intellectual boundaries. Quiet precision. Breath steady. She knows what she chose to study and why.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世界の飢餓問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also researched global hunger — that was in your work as well, correct?
lines.style: Engaged but gently quizzical. She's checking again — inviting Sakura to confirm or redirect. Genuine interest, not gotcha. Open posture in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、武士の自決の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, but through the lens of samurai seppuku — the history of self-determined death in times of crisis.
lines.style: Steady correction again. She's patient with being misunderstood. The words come with quiet authority. She's not defensive — she's clarifying her actual intellectual thread. Clear, unflinching.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文明の滅亡を巡る考古学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The archaeology of civilizations in collapse — that was your focus there, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering aloud. A teacher recognizing the pattern in what she's hearing. Slower pace. Genuine intellectual interest. Warm invitation to confirm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国際査察制度の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I looked at the history of international inspection systems — how oversight develops in response to threat.
lines.style: Final, patient correction. She's been quiet about what she really studied, and this is the last one. Not frustrated — matter-of-fact. She's done clarifying. Slight closure in her breath at the end.
